:- module(main, [main/0]).
:- use_module(library(readutil)).

main :-
    read_line_to_string(user_input, Line1),
    parse_int(Line1, N),
    read_scores(N, Scores, Rev),
    reverse(Rev, S),
    length(Scores, _),
    solve(N, S, Ans),
    format("~d~n", [Ans]).

read_scores(0, [], []) :- !.
read_scores(N, [X|T], [X|R]) :-
    N > 0,
    read_line_to_string(user_input, Line),
    parse_int(Line, X),
    N1 is N - 1,
    read_scores(N1, T, R).

parse_int(Line, X) :-
    split_string(Line, " \t\r\n", " \t\r\n", Parts),
    member(P, Parts),
    P \= "",
    number_string(X, P), !.

% S is list of scores, 1-indexed via nth1
solve(N, S, Ans) :-
    ( N =:= 1 ->
        nth1(1, S, A), Ans = A
    ; N =:= 2 ->
        nth1(1, S, A), nth1(2, S, B), Ans is A + B
    ;   nth1(1, S, A), nth1(2, S, B),
        D1 = A,
        D2 is A + B,
        nth1(3, S, C3),
        D3 is max(D1, C3) + C3,
        loop(4, N, S, D2, D3, Ans)
    ).

loop(I, N, _, _, D3, D3) :- I > N, !.
loop(I, N, S, D2, D3, Ans) :-
    nth1(I, S, Si),
    Im1 is I - 1, nth1(Im1, S, Sim1),
    D is max(D2, D3 - Sim1 + 0) + Si, % placeholder
    fail.
